_read_me: Every value here is an ASSUMPTION, not a confirmed spec. Each has a status of 'confirmed' or 'unconfirmed'. Replace the unconfirmed ones once the real numbers are known (3D-printed bobbin tolerance, wire spec sheet, course-stated safe current density, the x=d target's tolerance). Nothing else in the runner needs to change when you do — report.mjs reads this file and prints it verbatim.
toleranceModel: Each '3sigma' value below is interpreted as +/-3 standard deviations of a normal distribution (i.e. sigma = value / 3), per README.md section 3-5 of the implementation spec.

coilRadiusTolerance3Sigma_mm.note: 3D-printed bobbin radius tolerance — needs the actual printer/process spec.

coilSeparationTolerance3Sigma_mm.note: 3D-printed bobbin separation tolerance — needs the actual printer/process spec.

wireDiameterTolerance3Sigma_mm.note: Magnet wire diameter tolerance — needs the wire spec sheet.

turnCountTolerance.note: Turn count is exact by construction (counted, not measured).

safeCurrentDensity_A_per_mm2.note: Used by the web bench as 'jsafe'. Unclear whether this is a course-given number or a team-chosen safety margin.

task3EndTolerance_Oe.note: The project PDF states +/-1.0 Oe only for the 25 Oe (task 1 / task 3 start) target. The 10 Oe (task 3 end) tolerance is assumed equal for consistency — not stated in the PDF.

lastLayerTurnsSearchable.note: l1/l2 (last-layer turn counts) are treated as user-fixed, not search variables, in both the web UI and this runner.
